title: Answers on the Border
briefMd:
# Phase 1 · Answers on the Border

The IT how-to pages answer every question in two consecutive sentences: the step, then what follows from it ("Open the badge app and choose Reset PIN. The new PIN arrives by text message within five minutes."). A chunk boundary between the two cuts the answer in half, and with a tight context budget the chunks have to be small, so some boundary always lands in the wrong place.

You control **chunk size**, **overlap** (characters carried from the end of one chunk into the start of the next; only whole words or sentences are carried) and **split strategy**. Retrieval is BM25, top 5 chunks.

A question counts only when both sentences of its answer sit in one retrieved chunk.

**Gates:** recall@5 ≥ 0.90 and mean context tokens (top-5 chunks) ≤ 165 on the hidden set.
